build_phi3small_causal_lm: build a Phi3SmallForCausalLM model with Phi3Config and optional quantization config for autoregressive text generation
create_phi3small_decoder_layer: create a Phi3SmallDecoderLayer with config, layer id, quantization config, and prefix for self-attention and MLP blocks
run_phi3small_forward: run Phi3SmallForCausalLM forward pass with input_ids, positions, forward_batch, and optional inputs_embeds for inference
test_phi3small_attention: test Phi3SmallSelfAttention forward pass with positions, hidden_states, and forward_batch for rotary embeddings and blocksparse attention
review_phi3small_mlp: review Phi3SmallMLP with gegelu activation, merged up-projection, and row-wise down-projection for feedforward computation
